name: box_stitch_start
title: Box stitch start
about: The first box stitch of a boondoggle (scoubidou): two strings crossed at their middles, the halves of the first folded back into a loop on each side, the halves of the second woven over one leg and under the other, a crown of the four ends. Shown loose from above, the centre crossing drawn open in the middle; pulled tight it sinks under the four leg crossings, which make the two-by-two checkerboard.

steps.caption: Lay the gold string down the middle and fold both halves back beside it: the top half down on the left, the bottom half up on the right, a loop at each end.
Bring the teal string in from the left across the top: under the left gold leg, over the gold middle, over the right gold leg, and round to the right.
Bring it back across the centre: under the right gold leg, over the gold middle, where the two middles cross, and under the left gold leg.

Round the left, take the other teal half across the bottom: over the left gold leg, over the gold middle, under the right gold leg. Pull the four ends tight and the four leg crossings close into the checkerboard box.
